item: PASS,PASS / LOB,LOB / THROUGH,THROUGH double-tap window: a second tap 13 to 15 ticks after the first does not work, although T_INPUT.doubleTapTicks is 15 (brief item 6: 'PASS,PASS double-tap within doubleTapTicks dinked')
detail:
Confirmed with a scratch probe using the real src/sim/kicks/pass.ts (not the fakes). A PASS tap at ticks 1-2 plus a second tap 10, 11 or 12 ticks later converts to DINKED_PASS. With a gap of 13, 14 or 15 ticks, #9 plays only a GROUND_PASS.
- With AutoSwitch.OFF the second tap is lost.
- With the default AIR_AND_LOOSE, control has already moved to receiver #10. The second press goes into his buffer with PressFlag.DOUBLE and waits as a pending first-time press. At t79, after his FIRST_TOUCH, #10 plays a DINKED_PASS nobody asked for.

Cause: resolveActions.ts chargeTick ends a tapped kick's grace at pressTick + LOCAL_TUNING.tapGraceTicks (12). The real kickHandler then strikes, so convertPresses can no longer convert. Meanwhile isDoubleTap (resolveShared.ts:234) still marks the later press DOUBLE. It is tracked per controller, not per player, so the flag carries over to the newly controlled receiver.

The only window test ('a second press inside T_INPUT.doubleTapTicks while the first still winds up converts', sim-15-attack.test.ts:271) uses a 10-tick gap with fake handlers that never strike, so the window edge is untested.

Suggested fix:
- Make tapGraceTicks >= T_INPUT.doubleTapTicks, or derive it from that value.
- Drop the DOUBLE flag when ctl.slot changed since the previous press.
- Add an edge test at gap = doubleTapTicks with real kick contact timing.

item: §9 PASS swipe right 'low cross in the crossing zone' and swipe left 'ground cross in the crossing zone' are not produced (untested)
detail:
TCH-07 maps PASS swipe right to MOD_R+PASS. SIM-15 always sends that to startPass as DRIVEN_PASS. Probe: a player at (38,25) in the crossing zone pressing R1+PASS gets startPass:DRIVEN_PASS. startPass (SIM-08) has no crossing-zone conversion. SIM-09 converts only LOB_PASS->CROSS and DRIVEN_LOB->LOW_CROSS.

PASS swipe left maps to MOD_L+MOD_R+LOB, which becomes DRIVEN_LOB and then LOW_CROSS in the zone, not the ground cross §9 asks for.

The attack rows labelled '§9 PASS swipe right/left' (sim-15-attack.test.ts:54,59) test only outside the zone.

The two touch cells partly conflict with the §10 meanings of the same bits (R1+Cross is a driven ground pass; L1+R1+Square is a driven lob or cross), so the lead needs to decide. SIM-15 could at least resolve MOD_R+PASS inside geometry.inCrossingZone to startLob LOW_CROSS.
